name: melosong
description: Soundy — salons musicaux géolocalisés (Spotify, YouTube, Lives)

scripts.msdev: npm run msdev:sync-lan && npm run app:build && npm run dev:msdev --prefix backend
scripts.msdev:foreground: npm run app:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File msdev/scripts/open-msdev-foreground.ps1
scripts.msdev:https: npm run msdev:sync-lan:https && npm run app:build && npm run dev:msdev:https --prefix backend
scripts.app:dev:https: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:MSDEV_HTTPS_PROXY='1'; npm run dev --prefix app"
scripts.mobile:build: npm run apptel:build && npm run mobile:export
scripts.smartphone:build: npm run apptel:build && npm run smartphone:export && npm run mobile:export
scripts.capacitor:build: npm run msdev:sync-lan && npm run build:capacitor --prefix apptel
scripts.capacitor:sync:prod: npm run capacitor:build:prod && npm run cap:sync --prefix apptel
scripts.capacitor:android:apk: npm run capacitor:build && npm run cap:sync:android --prefix apptel && npm run android:apk --prefix apptel
scripts.capacitor:android:apk:prod: npm run capacitor:build:prod && npm run cap:sync:android --prefix apptel && npm run android:apk --prefix apptel
scripts.msdev:mobile: npm run msdev:sync-lan && npm run mobile:build && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File msdev/scripts/serve-mobile-tel.ps1
scripts.build:exe: npm run app:build && npm run build:exe --prefix backend
